name: resource-raiser
description: Answer natural-language questions from connected US government/nonprofit public datasets (nonprofit status, IRS 990 financials, Census, CDC PLACES, Treasury, USASpending, NIH RePORTER, College Scorecard, FEMA) using a local TechSoup/resource-raiser deployment instead of internet research. Detects whether the project has such a deployment, brings its local model stack up if needed, queries it, and calibrates trust in the answer by response shape.
